title: Pinscope A web-based remote access and vulnerability tracking solution for ESP32, Zephyr, Pico 2 W, and Linux SBCs
summary: Pinscope is a remote-access service for microcontroller-class devices like ESP32, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, and other MCUs running Zephyr, as well as Raspberry Pi/Linux single board computers. The web-based solution features live logs, metrics, and crash reports, supports OTA updates that stop and roll back in case of failure, and tracks CRA security vulnerabilities for all supported platforms. Pinscope highlights: Web UI The HTTP server already running on the device gets an HTTPS address of its own. Pages, APIs, and WebSockets work unchanged, behind the user s login, a share link, or an API token. No port forwarding, no VPN needed. Health reporting Heap, WiFi signal, chip temperature, restarts by reason, and the free stack of every task are reported with no code. Custom metrics can be added with one call. Logs ESP_LOG, Zephyr s LOG_*, printf, etc. are stored. title: Compact Edge AI camera packs Raspberry Pi CM5, Hailo-8 NPU, 12MP sensor, speaker and microphone
summary: Hellbender Tendryl Camera is an edge AI camera that integrates a Raspberry Pi CM5 module, a Hailo-8 AI accelerator, and a 12MP Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, as well as a speaker and microphone, into a compact fanless enclosure. The camera features a CM5 module with 4GB of RAM, a 16GB eMMC flash, and a wireless module for WiFi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. Other features include a Gigabit Ethernet with PoE+, a full-sized HDMI output port, three USB-C ports for power, data, and OS flashing, a 6-axis IMU, and a temperature, humidity, and pressure sensor. The company says the Tendryl Camera is designed to quickly prototype and build computer vision applications.
